verdict.rationale: A corporate registry could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only web filing through the Online Filing Centre and PDF forms, and the probe notes that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The open.canada.ca CKAN endpoint belongs to the national open-data platform, not to Corporations Canada, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the pack mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy.
